basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and puzzle enthusiast from Seattle, WA. I recently got into Spelunky and have been diving deep into its secrets and challenges. I work as a software developer during the day, which gives me a knack for problem-solving. I enjoy healthy eating and exploring new recipes, often posting about them in my free time. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after work, and on weekends. Currently single, I spend most of my time gaming or experimenting with new dishes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science and have been self-teaching game mechanics and strategies through online resources and forums. My professional experience as a software developer helps me understand the technical aspects of games, while my personal interest drives me to explore gaming communities.
